topic.title: Geothermal / Ground Source Heat Pumps / Groundwater
topic.source_contract: system type, borehole or abstraction geometry, hydrogeology, thermal design, abstraction and discharge, environmental permit or exemption, drilling, integrity, commissioning and long-term thermal and groundwater monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A heat-demand model is not treated as a proven geothermal resource.
A borehole plan is not treated as drilled and tested boreholes.
An exemption assessment is not treated as registered exemption.
A permit application is not treated as granted abstraction or discharge rights.
A pumping test is not treated as sustainable long-term yield.
Installed loops are not treated as pressure-tested and commissioned.
Initial coefficient of performance is not treated as long-term monitored performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact geology, permits, drilling, testing, commissioning and monitoring evidence.
